## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The baseline problem treats the tangential closing force as a specified piston-ring parameter and uses it to calculate mean/equivalent wall pressure. It does not replace the curved split ring with a straight beam or claim to predict the real local pressure distribution.
:::
